narr: A slow moving cold front brought showers and thunderstorms to the area on March 18th. Thunderstorms trained over the same areas in some instances, resulting in flash flooding due to heavy rain amounts of 4-7 inches falling in a short period of time. In addition, there were a couple of reports of downed trees and large hail.
ev: Flooding occurred on Roy Parker Road between N Union Ave and Troy Street.
Flooding was reported on Jernigan Road.
The west bound lanes of Highway 141 near Highway 84 were flooded.
Highway 125 just north of County Road 239 near Whitewater Church was flooded and impassable with traffic rerouted.
County Road 533 near County Road 537 was flooded.
County Road 474 near Kinston was flooded.
College Street in Enterprise was flooded.
Flooding was reported on the northeast side of Geneva.
A photo on facebook showed flooding on Cumbie Road at Highway 84.
A photo posted on Twitter showed flooding on Webb Road.
Homes were flooded on Academy Drive in Ashford according to a Twitter post.
